A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same Sculpting Memory research work. Their complete main texts, equations, tables, figures, and Appendices A–C are readable and support a reliable comparison.

before.justification: v1 reports original Stable Diffusion unlearning experiments on Imagenette and I2P, generation-quality evaluations, ablations, and additional quantitative and qualitative appendix results.

after.justification: v2 retains these original experiments and appendix results, including the proposed method's measured performance and component ablations.

M1.justification: Sections 3.2–3.3 retain the same dynamic gradient-mask updates, superclass/opposing-concept alignment, and teacher-based regularization. The algorithm and training objectives in Equations 1–12 are unchanged.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate Imagenette object unlearning, I2P NSFW unlearning including its sexual-prompt subset, and generation quality on MS-COCO. No dataset, domain, or test scenario is added or removed.

E2.justification: Comparator membership and method variants are unchanged within Tables 1–4 and 9 and the qualitative comparisons. UCE moves within the related-work discussion but retains its existing participation in Table 3.

E3.justification: The reported protocols remain identical: SD1.4, Adam with learning rate 3e-6 and batch size 2, 100 training and 200 testing images per class, the 931-prompt sexual subset, and NudeNet threshold 0.6. Evaluation metrics and ablation settings are also retained.

E4.justification: Section 4.4 and Appendix A.2 retain the same fixed-versus-dynamic mask comparison, sparsity/layer ablations, loss-weight sweeps, and mask-update-frequency analysis. The qualitative examples in the main text and appendices are unchanged.

E5.justification: Both versions report point estimates without repeated-run counts, seed information, confidence intervals, error bars, or significance tests. No statistical uncertainty-reporting practice changes.

E6.justification: All reported numerical results and qualitative findings are retained. For example, the proposed method's Total Accuracy remains 0.084, 0.093, and 0.140 for 10-, 3-, and 6-class unlearning, respectively, and Table 3 retains 47 detected NSFW elements. Ablation curves and appendix examples are unchanged.

T1.justification: The mathematical definitions and reasoning remain unchanged, including the mask-update rule, cosine schedule, diffusion equations, and loss definitions. Neither version adds a theorem, proof, or formal guarantee relative to the other.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same contributions and claims about adaptive masking, concept-aware loss, stable multi-concept forgetting, semantic alignment, and preservation of generation quality.

C2.justification: Both retain the same mechanism explanations and interpretations of forgetting versus fidelity. Appendix A.3's rationale for choosing object rather than artistic-style evaluation and the future-work discussion of compositional concepts and adversarial defenses are unchanged.

D1.justification: The abstract replaces v1's promise that code will be released with a statement of availability and a concrete GitHub repository link. Other implementation and training details are unchanged. The PDFs establish the access-information update, but not the repository's contents.

R1.justification: v2 adds three sparse-training references in Section 3.2, numbered 15, 16, and 21, and places UCE under multi-concept rather than single-concept forgetting in Section 2. These are limited additions and a classification refinement; the broader research positioning is retained.

P1.justification: Edits are localized to the code-access sentence, related-work paragraph arrangement, a diagram-label typo, and the arXiv version/date header. The paper's narrative, section sequence, and appendix organization remain substantially unchanged.

P2.justification: Figure 2 corrects 'uptede' to 'update'. Minor spacing and text reflow allow the conclusion to finish on page 8 instead of continuing onto page 9. No figures or tables are added or removed, and the appendix result pages are visually identical.

improvement.justification: v2 provides concrete code-access information in place of a release promise and modestly improves attribution, related-work classification, and presentation. These are limited practical improvements; the scientific methods, evidence, and uncertainty reporting remain unchanged. Repository contents cannot be verified from the supplied PDFs.
